newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 15.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 15.

text.p: -- General Motors Corp said late Thursday it expected an $870 million reduction in fourth quarter earnings due to recent strikes in the United States and Canada and costs associated with its new United Auto Workers contract.
The company also said its Delco Electronics unit faced a substantial decline in future profit margins from price cuts and the loss of GM-related business.
GM shares closed at 55-5/8 on Thursday.
-- ValuJet Inc said some of its top executives sold two million shares of ValuJet stock at $8.25 a share. ValuJet closed at 9-1/2 Thursday.
-- Life insurer PennCorp Financial Group Inc is expected to buy Washington National Corp for $400 million, or $29.50 a share, the Wall Street Journal said.
Washington National closed at 29-7/8 and PennCorp finished at 35-1/8.
